temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn for the past few days, which is uncharacteristic. When Carolyn asks, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is normally engaging and sociable; her recent quietness is unusual, but Carolyn does not yet know the cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Carolyn's concern is confirmed and partly specified: Marilyn is dealing with work and personal stress, though the details remain vague.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes Marilyn is overwhelmed by work and personal issues and may need support, but is not currently sharing much.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer support and be available to Marilyn without prying too much.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After Carolyn's earlier check-in, Marilyn was curt in a later interaction. Carolyn then shares that she has had tough times too and hopes she did not overstep. Marilyn apologizes for seeming off and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is overwhelmed, but after Marilyn's curtness she is unsure whether she overstepped or whether Marilyn is upset with her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's apology and explanation reframe the curtness as stress from a hard week rather than personal rejection or anger toward Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes Marilyn is not upset with her; Marilyn is having a hard week and appreciates Carolyn's support and understanding.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially confused and hurt; afterward reassured, sympathetic, and relieved.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear up any misunderstanding, show support, and maintain a supportive relationship with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded positively to Carolyn's openness. When Carolyn invites her to a small weekend gathering, Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks her, and accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes their last conversation went well and that Marilyn appreciates her openness; she is hopeful about a budding friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's positive response and acceptance strengthen Carolyn's belief that Marilyn is open to friendship and social connection outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes Marilyn is friendly, willing to socialize, and interested in building a closer friendship.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To strengthen the bond by hosting the gathering and continuing to include Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn as maintaining professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn raises this, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes that although they have been friendly outside work, Marilyn may still be keeping a professional distance or may not want the same closeness at work; she feels confused and disappointed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's response suggests the distance may have been unintended or not fully recognized, and she is willing to discuss and improve their work dynamic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes there is a work-dynamic issue to resolve, but Marilyn is open to talking about it and improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and confused, with cautious hope after Marilyn's response.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To directly address and understand their work dynamic, clarify expectations and boundaries, and improve collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn feels they cleared the air and understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries. She proposes teaming up on the new project; Marilyn agrees enthusiastically, says she is glad they talked, and looks forward to working closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have resolved their work-distance issue and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; she feels content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, positively. Marilyn's enthusiastic agreement confirms Carolyn's belief that their relationship and collaboration have improved.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes they are aligned, mutually understanding, and ready to work closely together as partners on the project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To collaborate with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their partnership.
